Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kanpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kanpur Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Project Associate-I position at IIT Kanpur is 08 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position under this recruitment notification (Advt No: P.Rect./R&D/2026/197) at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 31,000 plus 20% HRA, as per the prevailing institute norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Physics, Material Science, or Chemical Engineering, or a B.Tech degree in Material Science or Chemical Engineering to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. Is the job permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position at IIT Kanpur is temporary in nature, typically associated with specific research projects conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply online through the official link provided on the IIT Kanpur website or via the QR code mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I post involves two stages: shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and a subsequent interview process.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the IIT Kanpur Project Associate-I recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the job be located?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Associate-I position is at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur), Uttar Pradesh, pincode 208016.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be found on the IIT Kanpur Department of Research and Development website or through the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
